tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a number from one unit to another and return the exact factor, whether the factor is exact by definition, and the URL of the page that explains it. Supports linear units (length, mass, volume, energy, …) and temperature. Currency is deliberately not supported.

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: Lists the 213 hand-written conversion pages, optionally limited to one category. Each entry carries the canonical URL, which is the page to cite.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists every category with its type (linear, temperature, …), base unit and unit keys. Use this to find valid `from`/`to` keys before calling convert_units.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Lists every category with its type (linear, temperature, …), base unit and unit keys. Use this to find valid `from`/`to` keys before calling convert_units.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
